geeklist.title: - CLOSED - Downsizing Auction #1 - ENDS 1/9/2026 (Frostpunk, Roll Camera, Colosseum & more!)
geeklist.description:
[b][size=18]PLEASE READ BEFORE BIDDING!!!!![/size][/b]
This auction will end sometime in the evening of Friday, January 9th, 2026. I will randomly choose a time to prevent sniping.
[b]ITEM LISTING INFO[/b] - Items listed in alphabetical order. - Edition/version will be noted for each. - Conditions will also be listed for each, according to the guide below. If you would like to see pictures of the items in question, please DM me, and I will get back to you promptly. - All listings have a Starting Bid (SB) and a Buy it Now (BIN) amount. Bids below the starting bid will not be accepted.
Please remember that you are bidding on USED games. If your expectation is that there will be no wear/imperfections, please consider buying a new copy from the publisher or your FLGS.
[b]NIS[/b] = New In Shrink [b]LN[/b] = Like New = Opened but never played or played once and components are in excellent condition. [b]VG[/b] = Very Good = has been played once or more, still in very good condition, may have whitening/dings on the box and/or small signs of wear/use. [b]G[/b] = Good = well played, and it shows however I would not hesitate to gift this copy to a friend if they wanted it. Will have dings/whitening on the box and/or large signs of use.
[b]BIDDING INFO[/b] - Please bid in whole dollar amounts. - If you would like to guarantee a purchase, claim it with a BIN. After a BIN bid, if you are not interested in any other items add 'Ready to Check Out' to your BIN and I will mark the item sold through BGG Marketplace and reach out to you for your shipping details so that I can provide a final price.
[b]SHIPPING INFO[/b] - Items will be shipped from Denton, TX (76201) at the buyer's expense. - I use Pirateship and will select the cheapest UPS shipping option available. - I will only ship to the Continental US (no worldwide shipping and NO FORWARDING SERVICES) - I will get the item shipped out within 2 days after payment receipt is confirmed. - You may also request Local Pickup if you wish. Doing so also prevents you from paying Shipping Costs.
[b]BGG FEE[/b] BoardGameGeek will receive its standard fee from the final sale price.
[b]PAYMENT[/b] Payment will be handled via PayPal Friends & Family (F&F) or Venmo. I will provide the details for payment when I send the final cost.
Thank you for looking, and Happy Bidding!
